techs.name: Universal Translator
techs.effect: First contact with any species; makes Member World integration possible and doubles the first-contact bonus.

techs.name: Tachyon Detection Grid
techs.effect: Reveals cloaked ships crossing a network.

techs.name: Deflector Improvisation
techs.effect: Reroute the main deflector for one-off tricks: tachyon pulses, graviton beams, anomaly scans.

techs.name: Phasing Cloak
techs.effect: Pass through matter while cloaked. Any faction can research it; Federation use violates the Treaty of Algeron (diplomatic penalty if discovered).
